periods.analysis: Pediatric offices handed out 85 dental referral cards as the education strategy launched on time. The access study had no staff assigned until March and is Below Plan, so the goal starts at Caution.
periods.recommendations: Assign an analyst to map dental clinics against travel time and open talks with the Community Health Center.

periods.analysis: Referral cards rose to 140 and dental messages are now part of prenatal classes. The access study has early maps showing Dune Avenue and Seagrove with the longest trips, but no partner has committed to hosting closer services.
periods.recommendations: Finish the travel-time map and press the Community Health Center for a mobile dental decision.

periods.analysis: Education about routine dental care is on schedule, but the effort to bring services closer to residents has stalled while we wait on a site decision with Harborview Community Health Center. Until a location and funding source are confirmed, the access half of this goal stays at Caution.
periods.recommendations: Secure site and grant funding for a mobile dental unit before the next quarter closes.
